python3 - <<'PY'
import z3
print(z3.get_version_string())
x=z3.Int('x'); y=z3.Int('y')
o=z3.Optimize(); o.set(priority='box'); o.add(x>=0,x<=10,y>=0,y<=5,x+y<=12)
a=o.minimize(x); b=o.maximize(x); c=o.minimize(y); d=o.maximize(x+y)
print(o.check())
print(o.model())
for h in [a,b,c,d]:
 print(h, o.lower(h), o.upper(h))
print('eval',o.model().eval(x),o.model().eval(y))
